question: Apply the row operations $R_1\leftrightarrow R_3$ followed by $R_2\rightarrow R_2-2R_1$ to $$A=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -1 \\ 2 & 1 & 3 \\ 0 & -2 & 4\end{bmatrix}.$$ Write the resulting matrix.
explanation:
Interchange of rows
Applying $R_1\leftrightarrow R_3$, $$A\rightarrow\begin{bmatrix}0 & -2 & 4 \\ 2 & 1 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 & -1\end{bmatrix}$$
Row replacement
Now apply $R_2\rightarrow R_2-2R_1$. The new second row is $$[2,1,3]-2[0,-2,4]=[2,5,-5]$$
Resulting matrix
$$\begin{bmatrix}0 & -2 & 4 \\ 2 & 5 & -5 \\ 1 & 2 & -1\end{bmatrix}$$
